description.value:
Your hair/facial hair seems to change length and/or style

You appear to alter the colour of your hair, lips, skin or eyes

You fabricate a small facial blemish such as a scar

You fabricate a distinctive body marking or tattoo

The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection.

If you cast this spell multiple times you can have up to three of its effects active at a time, and you can dismiss any or all of these effects as an action.

Assassin magic
